# Blind benchmark results (generated by score_blind.py; do not edit by hand)

- Papers: 3. Annotator: tanvi.
- Integrity: all sealed files match SEALED_OUTPUTS.sha256. System code diff vs f77d311: none.
- Inputs: 19 EQUIVALENT_NOTATION verdicts (adjudications.csv), 13 notation aliases, 62 label corrections (tier iii only). Locked label files are not edited.
- Panel recall: 10/11 (91%) of the panels the annotator chose to inventory had a crop sent to the model. The inventory is a partial, annotator-selected list (DEVIATIONS A5/A6), so this is not literature-level recall and not a sample estimate.
- Timing (different tasks, different units): manual labeling 123 min for 8 labeled panels = 15.4 min per labeled panel (time log does not separate inventory from full annotation). Automated: 19.8 min wall-clock (Stage 1 + model) for 29 panels sent to the model = 40.9 s per panel sent. A human labels a panel the human chose; the system processes every crop it detects, including non-target ones.

This is 3 papers and 8 labeled panels from a deliberately diverse candidate pool, against one annotator. It is not a literature-wide accuracy figure.
